response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers necessary and appropriate costs for outpatient care, including treatment for injuries sustained during travel. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing (which would trigger A5.1), and the treatment is not cosmetic or planned (which would trigger A5.2)."}
